metadata.methods_description: Participants completed a visuomotor delayed match-to-sample task with interference. Each trial began with a colored square or diamond shown for 500 ms, followed by a 2900 ms delay during which participants reported the target color using a color wheel controlled by a knob. In two-thirds of trials, an interference task occurred at 900 ms involving a directional triangle requiring a button press with the corresponding hand; interference could be motor (gray triangle) or visuomotor (colored triangle with hue shifted from target color). The experiment consisted of 10 blocks of 120 trials each, including 240 baseline trials with no interference. EEG was recorded throughout, and raw (unpreprocessed) data along with behavioral data are included.
